verdict.rationale: incident.io exposes a documented REST API (OpenAPI 3.0 spec, per-tag JSON specs) and webhooks that could be used to pull out incidents, alerts, schedules, etc., giving a technical path to extract data, but there is no explicit 'export all your data' feature, bulk-export tool, or documented open-format full-account export/offboarding process. missing for 10: a dedicated data-export/backup feature, documentation of export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), and any account-closure/data-portability guarantee.
